name: Vesna Ito-Takyi
role: Structural breach and explosive ordnance specialist — demolitions expert
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Vesna Ito-Takyi is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 25, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rin — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. He works as a demolitions expert out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Vesna Ito-Takyi is one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Vesna Ito-Takyi is addicted to combat stims. Functions fine on them, can't function without them. The dependency is invisible to everyone except their street doc.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, profane, and vivid. Speaks in images — everything is a metaphor for violence or weather.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "Explosives are just engineering with a deadline. Usually a very short deadline."
"I don't blow things up. I perform structural rearrangement."
"The blast radius is your problem. My problem is making sure there's a blast."

story_hooks: A crew member from Vesna Ito-Takyi's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Vesna Ito-Takyi's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A dead drop Vesna Ito-Takyi maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: Vesna Ito-Takyi represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings. Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains)
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
breaking_points: Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible muscle definition from constant physical training. Long-limbed and economical in frame — built for precision and endurance rather than power.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and practical, swept back from forehead
physical_description.eye_color: Chrome iris rings with warm amber glow beneath — thermal and low-light augmentation visible as faint luminescence in dim conditions
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with East Asian undertones
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, angular features with high cheekbones and a narrow jaw. Skin is clear but marked by the wear of someone who lives in industrial zones — fine dust scarring visible in close inspection. No facial hair. Expression default is neutral, difficult to read.
distinguishing_marks: Thin radiating scar tissue at left temple extending into hairline — cortical implant removal site, keloid patterns visible when hair is pulled back
Pale linear scar running from left collarbone to sternum approximately 12cm — old injury, healed but prominent against skin tone
Fine white scarring across knuckles and back of both hands from years of handling volatile materials
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome iris rings with faint internal luminescence — most obvious feature. Eyes scan and focus with inhuman precision. Occasional thermal flare visible in dim light. Cortical bomb scar tissue at left temple. Unknown subcutaneous augmentations, but movement suggests enhanced proprioception or reflex augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical precision — every motion calculated and efficient. No wasted energy. Stance is balanced and reactive, as if always ready to shift weight or move quickly. Hands are still and controlled. Eyes track and focus unnaturally fast. Overall impression is coiled potential, not relaxation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear. Black reinforced cargo pants with utility webbing and mag-clips for tools. Worn synthetic leather jacket over tech-mesh undershirt in charcoal gray. Steel-toed work boots (Yamakasi brand — mid-tier industrial). Fingerless gloves with grip-gel palms. No unnecessary ornamentation. Everything serves a function. Clothes show signs of wear and chemical exposure but are meticulously maintained.
